terbaru.judul: A Price-Based Framework for Stochastic Portfolio Theory
terbaru.pelajaran: We develop a price-based framework for stochastic portfolio theory in which trading strategies are generated from nominal price weights and evaluated relative to a price-weighted benchmark.

terbaru.judul: Trading Strategy Optimization via Textual Gradient
terbaru.pelajaran: To address these challenges, we propose TradeGrad, an experience-guided textual-gradient framework for robust trading strategy optimization.

terbaru.judul: On BESS-Backed Trading on the Continuous Intraday Electricity Market
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces a novel trading strategy for storage, in which forecast-driven round trip trading takes priority and the BESS supplies a second route for closing out positions that the market would otherwise close at a distressed price.

terbaru.judul: Kyle meets time-inconsistency: a dynamic mean--variance informed trading problem
terbaru.pelajaran: We study a Kyle--Back model in which the informed trader has dynamic mean--variance preferences, leading to a time-inconsistent trading problem that is formulated as an intrapersonal game.

terbaru.judul: From Cointegration to Out-of-Sample Failure: A Pairs-Trading Case Study on PEP-KO
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper examines whether a cointegration-based pairs trading strategy between PepsiCo and The Coca-Cola Company is statistically robust and economically exploitable.

terbaru.judul: Convex Modeling of Price Cross-Impact over Time
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper models both effects with a convex quadratic cost.

terbaru.judul: Neural Calibration of a Complete Market Model
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a neural calibration method to construct a recombining binomial tree directly from a set of given option prices.

terbaru.judul: A note on markets with semi-static trading strategies
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce the concept of small cones of random variables and present a sufficient condition for the attainable positions in the market to be closed in probability.

terbaru.judul: Pragmatic Information, Computation, and the Efficient Market Hypothesis
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that a receiver at a given level in the hierarchy may be unable to extract pragmatic information from a message because it appears random, yet a receiver at a higher level in the hierarchy finds the message perfectly intelligible.

terbaru.judul: What survives honest evaluation? Leakage-safe, search-aware assessment of LLM-driven trading strategy discovery
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a strategy-discovery system that makes both corrections structural rather than procedural.
